title: Workflows
inputPlaceholder: Run input — e.g. alert summary or ticket text
emptySteps: Drag nodes from the left, or start from a security template
selectStep: Select a node on the canvas to edit
emptyRunLog: Step and control-flow events appear after a run
restoreVersion: Restore this version (creates a new version)
routerChoicesHint: Default branches path_a / path_b; names must match the CEL result.
studioHint: Drag nodes to automate security ops · publish for webhook & schedule
paletteDragHint: Drag onto canvas or containers; Shift multi-select; double-click focuses inspector; Del deletes
canvasEmpty: Empty canvas — start from a security template or drag a node
userInputSchemaHint: Approvals renders typed controls; field names go into resolution_data.user_input
publishHint: Publish this draft as the live revision for webhook/schedule
publishTriggersHint: Webhook and schedule always run the published revision. Save, then publish.
celPlaceholder: CEL expression — pick a hint or type
triggerNeedsPublishBody: Webhook and schedule only run the published revision. Save the draft, publish, then enable triggers.
triggerNeedsSavePublishBody: This draft differs from the last published revision. Save and publish again before enabling triggers so live traffic matches the canvas.
publishTriggersHintUnpublished: Not published yet: publish before enabling triggers. The API rejects enable when unpublished.
publishTriggersHintDirty: Draft changed since publish: triggers still run the old published revision — save then publish.
webhookSseHint: Response is an SSE stream (curl -N). Events include run_id / session_id for Trace.
webhookSaveFirst: Save the workflow first to get a webhook URL.
stepSkillsHint: At run time loads global-enabled ∩ bound names. Empty means no skills.
canvasTips: Drag to reorder; connect edges to resequence root steps. Router, nested workflows, version restore, and triggers are available.
listTruncated: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} workflows (page cap; deep links still open by id)
keyboardHints: Shortcuts: Ctrl/⌘S save · Z undo · Y redo · C/V copy/paste (multi-select paste → root) · A select all · L auto-layout · Esc stop run / clear selection · Del delete · double-click focuses inspector
multiSelectHint: {{count}} nodes selected — bulk actions only; select one node to edit
runBannerRunningDirty: Workflow running… (unsaved draft changes; save does not affect this run)
errorEditWhileRunning: A run is in progress — canvas structure is locked (you can still save; Esc to stop)
validationEmptyWorkflow: Add at least one node before saving
validationEmptyParallel: {{path}}: Parallel needs at least one branch
validationHitlInParallel: {{path}}: Step HITL is not allowed inside Parallel (Agno constraint)
validationEmptyCondition: {{path}}: Condition needs then and/or else steps
validationUserInputSchemaEmpty: {{path}}: user input needs at least one named field
errorTriggerNeedsPublish: Publish the workflow before enabling webhook or cron triggers
errorTriggerNeedsSavePublish: Save and publish the current draft before enabling triggers
canvasEmptyHint: Drag nodes from the left palette
canvasEmptyDrop: Drop onto the canvas — or onto a container to nest
stepNameHint: When empty, Run Log uses the executor display name (e.g. Security Operations).
multiSelectAgentHint: Bulk-edit executor, Skills, instructions, and HITL (confirm / user input / output review) for selected Agent steps.
multiSelectNoAgents: No Agent steps in the current multi-selection (control-flow only).
multiSelectSkillsPlaceholder: Bind Skills for selected agents (replaces existing)
multiSelectSkillsMixed: Selected steps have different Skills; choosing options replaces all bindings. Clear removes Skills from all.
multiSelectInstructionsMixed: Selected steps have different instructions; typing replaces all…
multiSelectInstructionsHint: Instructions differ across selection; edits apply to every selected Agent step.
hitlBlockedInParallel: Parallel branches cannot pause for step HITL. Move the step out of Parallel or clear HITL.
multiSelectHitlParallelHint: HITL cannot be enabled on steps inside Parallel; those selections are skipped.
pasteMultiSelectRoot: Multiple nodes selected — paste appended at canvas root
pasteEmptyClipboard: Nothing to paste — copy a node first (Ctrl/⌘C)
cancelServerFailed: Stopped locally, but server cancel failed
discardDirtyContent: You have unsaved edits. Loading or resetting will discard them.
deleteSavedContent: This permanently removes the saved workflow and its versions.
deleteSavedDirtyContent: You have unsaved edits. Deleting still removes the saved workflow permanently.
stopRunBeforeLeaveContent: A workflow run is still in progress. Stop it before loading or resetting the canvas.
deleteSavedRunningContent: A run is still in progress. Deleting will stop it and permanently remove the workflow.
leaveWhileRunningTitle: Leave while a run is active?
leaveWhileRunningContent: A workflow run is still in progress. Leave will stop it. Unsaved draft edits may also be lost.
leaveWhileDirtyContent: You have unsaved workflow edits. Leave without saving will discard them.
reparentCycleBlocked: Cannot move a node into its own branch
pasteHitlDiverted: {{count}} HITL step(s) cannot live inside Parallel — placed at root instead
reparentHitlBlocked: Steps with HITL cannot move into a Parallel branch
multiSelectHitlSkipped: Skipped HITL on {{count}} step(s) inside Parallel
